name: bbpc-monorepo
description: BBPC applications and shared Convex backend

scripts.build: pnpm run build:contracts && pnpm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: pnpm --filter bbpc run build && pnpm --filter bbpc-admin run build && pnpm --filter bbpc-recording run build
scripts.check: pnpm run check:backend && pnpm run check:apps
scripts.check:apps: pnpm --filter bbpc run typecheck && pnpm --filter bbpc run test && pnpm --filter bbpc-admin run typecheck && pnpm --filter bbpc-admin run test && pnpm --filter bbpc-recording run typecheck && pnpm --filter bbpc-recording run test
scripts.test: pnpm --filter './apps/*' run test && pnpm --filter @tonyisup/bbpc-convex-api run test
